segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Hi, yeah, I'm calling about invoice 48291 from July 31. It shows 74 seats at $18, but we only have 68 active seats in the admin console, so the total is $108 higher than we expected.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it. Let me pull that up in the billing tool. Can I confirm the account name is Northlake Components and you're calling from the finance team?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right. This is Dana Mills. We usually pay by ACH, but I paused this one until we understood it.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Totally fine. I have the account open. I see the July invoice and the current seat count. Give me one second to check the usage snapshot tied to billing, because that's what drives the final count.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Okay, yeah, I see what happened. Six deactivated users were still marked billable during the July 28 snapshot. They show inactive now, but the billing status didn't update at the same time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that makes sense. Can you correct it, or do we need to wait for a credit next month?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I can submit an adjustment from here. It'll generate a revised invoice with the same invoice number and a -$108 line, usually within about 30 minutes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. We need to close month-end by Friday, so today would be helpful.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, I'll mark it priority. I'm also opening ticket 317642 so you have a reference. You'll get an email when the revised PDF is ready.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to unpause the ACH after that, or will it retry automatically?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You'll need to approve it manually in the billing portal once the revised balance posts. The due date stays August 15, so there's no late fee risk right now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, thanks. I'll watch for the email.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You're welcome. I'll send the ticket confirmation now.
